name: Configure
description: User context for agents: users bring approved memories and connected apps across ChatGPT, Claude and other agents, which read and write a shared profile via MCP, API or SDK.

skills.name: Read User Profile
skills.description: Read a user's approved profile, including identity, preferences and a summary, to personalize from the first turn.

skills.name: Search User Memories
skills.description: Search a user's saved memories by words, category, source or date across every agent they connected.

skills.name: Save and Forget Memories
skills.description: Save facts the user asks to keep, commit each turn, and delete memories the agent saved.

skills.name: Import Assistant Memories
skills.description: Let users import what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok already know about them, and connect apps like Gmail.
